name: HPS
summary: HPS is a dedicated high-intensity electron fixed-target experiment in Jefferson Lab Hall B, Newport News, Virginia.
detection_principle: Electrons strike a thin tungsten target to produce dark photons; a forward spectrometer seeks narrow e⁺e⁻ peaks and displaced decay vertices.

results.summary: A displaced-vertex search for strongly interacting dark-sector particles was published; this entry makes no discovery claim.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
